scenes.headline: How GVA drops the key cache and rebuilds keys
scenes.sub: Grouped Value Attention, one linear map per head
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Opal! Grouped Value Attention stops caching keys altogether. Here's how it rebuilds them from the values, almost for free.

scenes.text: Cache only the grouped values. Each query head rebuilds its content key from them with a learned linear map, folded into the query.
scenes.say: Cache only the grouped values. Each query head rebuilds its content key from them with a learned map, and that map is folded into the query.

scenes.title: Why rebuilding the key is free
scenes.say: Why is that free? Because matrix products associate.

parts.note: a key rebuilt from a cached value by the head's map
parts.say: On the left, the query meets a key rebuilt from a cached value.

parts.note: the query, transformed once per decoded token
parts.say: On the right, transform the query once, then score it straight against the values.

steps.say: At decode, the query's content half is multiplied by its head's map, once per token, then scored against every cached value.
Rotary position would break that fold, so a small rotated key is kept too: one per token, shared by all heads.
Add the two scores, take the softmax, and weight the same cached values.

scenes.label: fewer persistent cache scalars than matched GQA
scenes.note: half, plus a small tax for the shared positional key
scenes.say: That cuts the cached scalars by forty-five to forty-seven percent against matched GQA: half, plus a small tax for the positional key.

scenes.title: Average over five benchmarks, against baselines, 350M
scenes.note: three seeds, no error bars; no decoding kernel released yet
scenes.say: At three hundred fifty million parameters, it scored forty-four point three five against GQA's forty-four point three six. That's small scale, and no decoding kernel is public yet.

scenes.text: If the key can be rebuilt from the value by a map folded into the query, cache only the value.

recap: A per-head map, folded into the query
A small shared rotary key keeps position
scenes.say: To recap: cache values, not keys; fold each head's map into the query; keep one small rotary key.
